repeats.name: Raul
repeats.line: You watch who eats with whom, who laughs a little too loud at whose jokes. Nothing solid. Keep looking.

repeats.name: Ines
repeats.line: Another pass over the same ground. Somebody's being careful. Careful people leave cleaner trails — and cleaner trails are still trails.
